verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual says the button beside the commit message field can suggest messages using AI, generated by sending staged differences to OpenAI. That is exactly the story: AI suggestions based on staged changes. The homepage lists commit suggestions as opt-in. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality, deeper documentation of how suggestions are generated or configured.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated commit message suggestions based on my staged changes

citations.quote: includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence. These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI
